config_dir.description: Alternate Claws Mail configuration directory (same as -a/--alternate-config-dir)

clawsrc.description: Explicit Claws Mail resource configuration filename (overrides -c/--clawsrc)

use_claws_version.description: Target Claws Mail version in dot-separated integers (e.g., '3.17.8'; same as -u/--use-claws-version)

hide_disabled_keys.description: Hide unassigned hotkeys in UI (same as -k/--hide-disabled-keys)

read_only.description: Run in read-only mode (no changes saved; same as -r/--read-only)

small_screen.description: Force UI adjustments for small screens (same as -s/--small-screen)
